import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(28, 20), dpi=150)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#0D1117')
ax.set_facecolor('#0D1117')
ax.set_xlim(-1, 21)
ax.set_ylim(-2.5, 16.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# Color palette - data-dense technical style
C_BG = '#0D1117'
C_PRODUCER = '#58A6FF'
C_CONSUMER = '#7EE787'
C_PRODCONS = '#D2A8FF'
C_TOPIC = '#FFA657'
C_DLQ = '#FF7B72'
C_SCHEMA = '#79C0FF'
C_MONITOR = '#FFC658'
C_ALERT = '#FF9B9B'
C_GRAFANA = '#56D364'
C_PAGER = '#FF6B6B'
C_SLACK = '#D2A8FF'
C_TEXT = '#E6EDF3'
C_SUBTEXT = '#8B949E'
C_EDGE_HAPPY = '#58A6FF'
C_EDGE_DLQ = '#FF7B72'
C_EDGE_SCHEMA = '#79C0FF'
C_EDGE_MONITOR = '#FFC658'

def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, sublabel, color, alpha=0.15, fontsize=9, text_color=C_TEXT, bold=True):
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", linewidth=1.5,
                           edgecolor=color, facecolor=color + '22',
                           zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    weight = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    ax.text(x, y + 0.15, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
            fontweight=weight, color=text_color, zorder=4)
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(x, y - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=C_SUBTEXT, zorder=4, style='italic')

def draw_topic_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, sublabel, color, is_dlq=False):
    ls = '--' if is_dlq else '-'
    lw = 1.2 if is_dlq else 1.5
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", linewidth=lw,
                           edgecolor=color, facecolor=color + '18',
                           linestyle=ls, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x, y + 0.12, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5,
            fontweight='bold', color=color, zorder=4, family='monospace')
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(x, y - 0.2, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
                color=C_SUBTEXT, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, style='-', lw=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=2, connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.0", shrinkA=12, shrinkB=12):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2),
                             arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=10,
                             color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                             connectionstyle=connectionstyle,
                             linestyle=style, zorder=zorder,
                             shrinkA=shrinkA, shrinkB=shrinkB)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ===== LAYOUT =====
# Left column: Producer services (x=1)
# Center: Kafka Topics (x=7-8)
# Right column: Consumer services (x=14)
# Far right: DLQs (x=18)
# Top: Schema Registry (x=10, y=15)
# Bottom: Monitoring pipeline

# --- MICROSERVICES ---
svc_positions = {}

# Producer side (left)
svc_positions['svc-order'] = (1.5, 12)

# Producer-Consumer (middle-left)
svc_positions['svc-payment'] = (1.5, 9)
svc_positions['svc-inventory'] = (1.5, 6)

# Consumer (right side)
svc_positions['svc-shipping'] = (14.5, 10)
svc_positions['svc-notification'] = (14.5, 7)
svc_positions['svc-analytics'] = (14.5, 4)

# Draw microservices
svc_colors = {
    'svc-order': C_PRODUCER,
    'svc-payment': C_PRODCONS,
    'svc-inventory': C_PRODCONS,
    'svc-shipping': C_CONSUMER,
    'svc-notification': C_CONSUMER,
    'svc-analytics': C_CONSUMER,
}

svc_info = {s['id']: s for s in data['microservices']['data']}
role_labels = {'producer': 'PRODUCER', 'consumer': 'CONSUMER', 'producer-consumer': 'PROD/CONS'}

for sid, (x, y) in svc_positions.items():
    s = svc_info[sid]
    color = svc_colors[sid]
    rl = role_labels[s['role']]
    retry = ''
    rp = [r for r in data['retry_policies']['data'] if r['service_id'] == sid]
    if rp and rp[0]['strategy'] != 'none':
        retry = f"retry: {rp[0]['strategy']} (max {rp[0]['max_retries']})"
    sublabel = f"{rl} · {s['domain']}"
    if retry:
        sublabel += f"\n{retry}"
    draw_box(ax, x, y, 2.6, 1.2, s['name'], sublabel, color, fontsize=10)

# --- KAFKA TOPICS (center column) ---
topic_positions = {}
# Business topics
biz_topics = [t for t in data['kafka_topics']['data'] if t['category'] != 'dlq']
topic_x = 8.0
topic_ys = np.linspace(13, 3, len(biz_topics))

for i, t in enumerate(biz_topics):
    x = topic_x
    y = topic_ys[i]
    topic_positions[t['topic_name']] = (x, y)
    tp_info = f"p={t['partitions']} · {t['peak_throughput_msg_sec']} msg/s"
    draw_topic_box(ax, x, y, 2.8, 0.75, t['topic_name'], tp_info, C_TOPIC)

# DLQ topics (far right bottom)
dlq_topics = [t for t in data['kafka_topics']['data'] if t['category'] == 'dlq']
dlq_x = 18.5
dlq_ys = np.linspace(12, 6, len(dlq_topics))

for i, t in enumerate(dlq_topics):
    x = dlq_x
    y = dlq_ys[i]
    topic_positions[t['topic_name']] = (x, y)
    tp_info = f"retention: {t['retention_hours']}h · {t['peak_throughput_msg_sec']} msg/s"
    draw_topic_box(ax, x, y, 2.6, 0.75, t['topic_name'], tp_info, C_DLQ, is_dlq=True)

# --- KAFKA CLUSTER LABEL ---
kafka_rect = FancyBboxPatch((6.2, 2.2), 4.0, 11.8,
                             boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", linewidth=2.0,
                             edgecolor=C_TOPIC + '66', facecolor=C_TOPIC + '08',
                             linestyle='--', zorder=1)
ax.add_patch(kafka_rect)
ax.text(8.2, 14.5, 'KAFKA CLUSTER', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11,
        fontweight='bold', color=C_TOPIC, zorder=4, family='monospace',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor=C_TOPIC + '55', linewidth=1))

# DLQ region
dlq_rect = FancyBboxPatch((16.8, 5.2), 3.4, 8.3,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", linewidth=1.5,
                            edgecolor=C_DLQ + '44', facecolor=C_DLQ + '06',
                            linestyle='--', zorder=1)
ax.add_patch(dlq_rect)
ax.text(18.5, 13.8, 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=C_DLQ, zorder=4, family='monospace',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor=C_DLQ + '44', linewidth=1))

# --- SCHEMA REGISTRY ---
schema_pos = (8.0, 15.5)
draw_box(ax, schema_pos[0], schema_pos[1], 3.0, 0.9, 'Schema Registry',
         'Avro validation · sync-http', C_SCHEMA, fontsize=10)

# --- EVENT FLOW ARROWS ---
flows = data['event_flows']['data']

for flow in flows:
    src = flow['source']
    tgt = flow['target']
    ft = flow['flow_type']

    if src in svc_positions:
        x1, y1 = svc_positions[src]
    elif src in topic_positions:
        x1, y1 = topic_positions[src]
    else:
        continue

    if tgt in svc_positions:
        x2, y2 = svc_positions[tgt]
    elif tgt in topic_positions:
        x2, y2 = topic_positions[tgt]
    elif tgt == 'schema-registry':
        x2, y2 = schema_pos
    else:
        continue

    if ft == 'produce':
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_HAPPY, lw=1.3, alpha=0.65,
                   connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.05")
    elif ft == 'consume':
        rad = 0.0
        if abs(y1 - y2) < 2:
            rad = 0.1
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_HAPPY, lw=1.0, alpha=0.45,
                   connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}")
    elif ft == 'dlq-produce':
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_DLQ, style='--', lw=1.5, alpha=0.7,
                   connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.15")
    elif ft == 'schema-lookup':
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_SCHEMA, style=':', lw=0.8, alpha=0.4,
                   connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.1")

# --- MONITORING & ALERTING PIPELINE ---
mon_y_base = -0.8
prom_pos = (5.0, mon_y_base)
grafana_pos = (9.0, mon_y_base)
alertmgr_pos = (13.0, mon_y_base)
pagerduty_pos = (16.5, mon_y_base - 1.0)
slack_pos = (16.5, mon_y_base + 0.0)

draw_box(ax, *prom_pos, 2.5, 0.9, 'Prometheus', 'metric collection', C_MONITOR, fontsize=9)
draw_box(ax, *grafana_pos, 2.2, 0.9, 'Grafana', 'dashboards', C_GRAFANA, fontsize=9)
draw_box(ax, *alertmgr_pos, 2.5, 0.9, 'Alertmanager', 'alert routing', C_ALERT, fontsize=9)
draw_box(ax, *pagerduty_pos, 2.0, 0.65, 'PagerDuty', 'critical alerts', C_PAGER, fontsize=8)
draw_box(ax, *slack_pos, 2.0, 0.65, 'Slack', 'warning alerts', C_SLACK, fontsize=8)

# Monitoring region
mon_rect = FancyBboxPatch((-0.5, -2.2), 20.0, 2.8,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", linewidth=1.5,
                           edgecolor=C_MONITOR + '44', facecolor=C_MONITOR + '06',
                           linestyle='--', zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(mon_rect)
ax.text(0.3, 0.8, 'MONITORING & ALERTING', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=C_MONITOR, zorder=4, family='monospace',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor=C_MONITOR + '44', linewidth=1))

# Monitoring arrows from services to Prometheus
for sid, (sx, sy) in svc_positions.items():
    draw_arrow(ax, sx, sy, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], C_EDGE_MONITOR, style=':',
               lw=0.7, alpha=0.3, connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.0")

# Kafka cluster to Prometheus
draw_arrow(ax, 8.0, 2.5, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], C_EDGE_MONITOR, style=':',
           lw=0.7, alpha=0.3)

# Schema Registry to Prometheus
draw_arrow(ax, schema_pos[0], schema_pos[1], prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], C_EDGE_MONITOR,
           style=':', lw=0.7, alpha=0.3, connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.1")

# Prometheus to Grafana
draw_arrow(ax, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], grafana_pos[0], grafana_pos[1],
           C_MONITOR, lw=1.3, alpha=0.6)

# Prometheus to Alertmanager
draw_arrow(ax, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], alertmgr_pos[0], alertmgr_pos[1],
           C_MONITOR, lw=1.3, alpha=0.6)

# Alertmanager to PagerDuty and Slack
draw_arrow(ax, alertmgr_pos[0], alertmgr_pos[1], pagerduty_pos[0], pagerduty_pos[1],
           C_PAGER, lw=1.2, alpha=0.6)
draw_arrow(ax, alertmgr_pos[0], alertmgr_pos[1], slack_pos[0], slack_pos[1],
           C_SLACK, lw=1.2, alpha=0.6)

# Alert rules annotations
alert_rules = ['consumer_lag_critical', 'dlq_message_rate_high', 'service_health_down']
for i, rule in enumerate(alert_rules):
    ax.text(10.0, mon_y_base + 0.65 + i * 0.28, f"▸ {rule}", fontsize=5.5,
            color=C_ALERT, ha='left', va='center', family='monospace', alpha=0.7)

# --- TITLE ---
ax.text(10.0, 16.3, 'Event-Driven Architecture — Kafka Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT,
        family='sans-serif')

# --- LEGEND ---
legend_x = -0.3
legend_y = 15.8
legend_items = [
    (C_PRODUCER, '—', 'Producer Service'),
    (C_PRODCONS, '—', 'Producer/Consumer Service'),
    (C_CONSUMER, '—', 'Consumer Service'),
    (C_TOPIC, '—', 'Kafka Topic'),
    (C_DLQ, '- -', 'Dead Letter Queue'),
    (C_EDGE_HAPPY, '→', 'Happy Path (produce/consume)'),
    (C_EDGE_DLQ, '⇢', 'DLQ / Error Path'),
    (C_EDGE_SCHEMA, '···', 'Schema Validation (sync)'),
    (C_EDGE_MONITOR, '···', 'Metric Scrape'),
]

for i, (color, sym, label) in enumerate(legend_items):
    yy = legend_y - i * 0.42
    ax.plot(legend_x, yy, 's', color=color, markersize=7, zorder=5)
    ax.text(legend_x + 0.35, yy, label, fontsize=7, color=C_TEXT, va='center', zorder=5)

plt.tight_layout(pad=1.0)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',

print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

        fontweight='bold', color=C_TOPIC, zorder=4, family='monospace',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor=C_TOPIC + '55', linewidth=1))

# DLQ region
dlq_rect = FancyBboxPatch((16.8, 5.2), 3.4, 8.3,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", linewidth=1.5,
                            edgecolor=C_DLQ + '44', facecolor=C_DLQ + '06',
                            linestyle='--', zorder=1)
ax.add_patch(dlq_rect)
ax.text(18.5, 13.8, 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=C_DLQ, zorder=4, family='monospace',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor=C_DLQ + '44', linewidth=1))

# --- SCHEMA REGISTRY ---
schema_pos = (8.0, 15.5)
draw_box(ax, schema_pos[0], schema_pos[1], 3.0, 0.9, 'Schema Registry',
         'Avro validation · sync-http', C_SCHEMA, fontsize=10)

# --- EVENT FLOW ARROWS ---
flows = data['event_flows']['data']

for flow in flows:
    src = flow['source']
    tgt = flow['target']
    ft = flow['flow_type']

    if src in svc_positions:
        x1, y1 = svc_positions[src]
    elif src in topic_positions:
        x1, y1 = topic_positions[src]
    else:
        continue

    if tgt in svc_positions:
        x2, y2 = svc_positions[tgt]
    elif tgt in topic_positions:
        x2, y2 = topic_positions[tgt]
    elif tgt == 'schema-registry':
        x2, y2 = schema_pos
    else:
        continue

    if ft == 'produce':
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_HAPPY, lw=1.3, alpha=0.65,
                   connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.05")
    elif ft == 'consume':
        rad = 0.0
        if abs(y1 - y2) < 2:
            rad = 0.1
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_HAPPY, lw=1.0, alpha=0.45,
                   connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}")
    elif ft == 'dlq-produce':
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_DLQ, style='--', lw=1.5, alpha=0.7,
                   connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.15")
    elif ft == 'schema-lookup':
        draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, C_EDGE_SCHEMA, style=':', lw=0.8, alpha=0.4,
                   connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.1")

# --- MONITORING & ALERTING PIPELINE ---
mon_y_base = -0.8
prom_pos = (5.0, mon_y_base)
grafana_pos = (9.0, mon_y_base)
alertmgr_pos = (13.0, mon_y_base)
pagerduty_pos = (16.5, mon_y_base - 1.0)
slack_pos = (16.5, mon_y_base + 0.0)

draw_box(ax, *prom_pos, 2.5, 0.9, 'Prometheus', 'metric collection', C_MONITOR, fontsize=9)
draw_box(ax, *grafana_pos, 2.2, 0.9, 'Grafana', 'dashboards', C_GRAFANA, fontsize=9)
draw_box(ax, *alertmgr_pos, 2.5, 0.9, 'Alertmanager', 'alert routing', C_ALERT, fontsize=9)
draw_box(ax, *pagerduty_pos, 2.0, 0.65, 'PagerDuty', 'critical alerts', C_PAGER, fontsize=8)
draw_box(ax, *slack_pos, 2.0, 0.65, 'Slack', 'warning alerts', C_SLACK, fontsize=8)

# Monitoring region
mon_rect = FancyBboxPatch((-0.5, -2.2), 20.0, 2.8,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", linewidth=1.5,
                           edgecolor=C_MONITOR + '44', facecolor=C_MONITOR + '06',
                           linestyle='--', zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(mon_rect)
ax.text(0.3, 0.8, 'MONITORING & ALERTING', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8,
        fontweight='bold', color=C_MONITOR, zorder=4, family='monospace',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor=C_MONITOR + '44', linewidth=1))

# Monitoring arrows from services to Prometheus
for sid, (sx, sy) in svc_positions.items():
    draw_arrow(ax, sx, sy, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], C_EDGE_MONITOR, style=':',
               lw=0.7, alpha=0.3, connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.0")

# Kafka cluster to Prometheus
draw_arrow(ax, 8.0, 2.5, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], C_EDGE_MONITOR, style=':',
           lw=0.7, alpha=0.3)

# Schema Registry to Prometheus
draw_arrow(ax, schema_pos[0], schema_pos[1], prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], C_EDGE_MONITOR,
           style=':', lw=0.7, alpha=0.3, connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.1")

# Prometheus to Grafana
draw_arrow(ax, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], grafana_pos[0], grafana_pos[1],
           C_MONITOR, lw=1.3, alpha=0.6)

# Prometheus to Alertmanager
draw_arrow(ax, prom_pos[0], prom_pos[1], alertmgr_pos[0], alertmgr_pos[1],
           C_MONITOR, lw=1.3, alpha=0.6)

# Alertmanager to PagerDuty and Slack
draw_arrow(ax, alertmgr_pos[0], alertmgr_pos[1], pagerduty_pos[0], pagerduty_pos[1],
           C_PAGER, lw=1.2, alpha=0.6)
draw_arrow(ax, alertmgr_pos[0], alertmgr_pos[1], slack_pos[0], slack_pos[1],
           C_SLACK, lw=1.2, alpha=0.6)

# Alert rules annotations
alert_rules = ['consumer_lag_critical', 'dlq_message_rate_high', 'service_health_down']
for i, rule in enumerate(alert_rules):
    ax.text(10.0, mon_y_base + 0.65 + i * 0.28, f"▸ {rule}", fontsize=5.5,
            color=C_ALERT, ha='left', va='center', family='monospace', alpha=0.7)

# --- TITLE ---
ax.text(10.0, 16.3, 'Event-Driven Architecture — Kafka Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT,
        family='sans-serif')

# --- LEGEND ---
legend_x = -0.3
legend_y = 15.8
legend_items = [
    (C_PRODUCER, '—', 'Producer Service'),
    (C_PRODCONS, '—', 'Producer/Consumer Service'),
    (C_CONSUMER, '—', 'Consumer Service'),
    (C_TOPIC, '—', 'Kafka Topic'),
    (C_DLQ, '- -', 'Dead Letter Queue'),
    (C_EDGE_HAPPY, '→', 'Happy Path (produce/consume)'),
    (C_EDGE_DLQ, '⇢', 'DLQ / Error Path'),
    (C_EDGE_SCHEMA, '···', 'Schema Validation (sync)'),
    (C_EDGE_MONITOR, '···', 'Metric Scrape'),
]

for i, (color, sym, label) in enumerate(legend_items):
    yy = legend_y - i * 0.42
    ax.plot(legend_x, yy, 's', color=color, markersize=7, zorder=5)
    ax.text(legend_x + 0.35, yy, label, fontsize=7, color=C_TEXT, va='center', zorder=5)

plt.tight_layout(pad=1.0)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=C_BG, edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.5)
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
